svg.title: Benchmark
svg.text: Benchmark: 1,500 standard container loads, every box fully supported
Space used per test set (BR1–BR15, 100 loads each; more box sizes to the right). Published results: Gonçalves & Resende (2012), Table 4.
Every one of our 4,500 plans was checked box by box: 0 invalid. Published methods ran on other computers; times as reported.
